stories.story_fr: La reassurance a bondi: resultat technique de 441 M USD au T1 2026 contre 167 M un an plus tot, avec un ratio combine ramene de 91,8% a 75,9% porte par une charge cat divisee par trois.
stories.story_en: Reinsurance surged: underwriting income of $441M in Q1 2026 versus $167M a year earlier, with the combined ratio cut from 91.8% to 75.9% as catastrophe load fell by two-thirds.
stories.signal: Reassurance plus rentable, charge cat en forte baisse
stories.quote: Reinsurance Segment ... Underwriting income $ 441 ... Combined ratio 75.9 % 91.8 % ... Current accident year catastrophic events 5.2 % 18.3 %

stories.story_fr: Le segment hypothecaire reste une machine a marge: ratio combine de 22,3% au T1 2026, aide par 19,2 points de developpement favorable des reserves, signe d'une qualite de credit qui se confirme.
stories.story_en: The mortgage segment remains a margin machine: 22.3% combined ratio in Q1 2026, helped by 19.2 points of favorable reserve development, reflecting confirmed credit quality.
stories.quote: Mortgage Segment ... Combined ratio 22.3 % 16.1 % ... Net (favorable) adverse development in prior year loss reserves ... Loss ratio impact (19.2) %

stories.story_fr: Arch a genere un ROE operationnel annualise de 15,4% au T1 2026 tout en rachetant 783 M USD d'actions, illustrant une allocation de capital disciplinee a travers le cycle.
stories.story_en: Arch generated a 15.4% annualized operating ROE in Q1 2026 while repurchasing $783M of shares, illustrating disciplined capital allocation through the cycle.
stories.signal: ROE eleve et rachats massifs simultanes
stories.quote: annualized operating return on average common equity of 15.4% ... Share repurchases of $783 million

stories.story_fr: Le groupe a enregistre 200 M USD de developpement favorable des reserves d'annees anterieures au T1 2026, preuve d'un provisionnement prudent qui soutient la sur-performance du ratio combine.
stories.story_en: The group booked $200M of favorable prior-year reserve development in Q1 2026, evidence of prudent reserving that underpins combined-ratio outperformance.
stories.signal: Reserves prudentes liberees, qualite de provisionnement
stories.quote: Favorable development in prior year loss reserves, net of related adjustments, of $200 million
